claim: On the now-proven deterministic CPU trajectory, separate insufficient optimization horizon from tiny-model capacity at the fixed four-document break point.

fixed_recipe.objective: assistant-turn-only including the next canonical user-role delimiter
fixed_recipe.schedule: 50-step linear warmup then cosine to 0.1 peak ratio at each registered endpoint

gates.baseline_reproduction: exact deterministic CPU reference teacher top-1, target-prefix 2/4 and structural 1/4
gates.arm_memorization: teacher top-1 >= 0.95, exact response 4/4, target-prefix 4/4 and structural 4/4
gates.prompt_causality: normal gold-response CE below blank and cyclic-shuffle controls on 4/4, with normal output changed by at least one intervention on 4/4
gates.interpretation: an arm passes only when both memorization and prompt-causality gates pass

decision_table.BASELINE_MISMATCH: invalid experiment; do not interpret treatments
decision_table.ONLY_CAPACITY_PASS: support tiny capacity or geometry at the fixed horizon
decision_table.O1_AND_CAPACITY_PASS: both levers can fit four documents; require later compute-matched selection
decision_table.NO_TREATMENT_PASS: bounded horizon and capacity variants do not repair conditional learning
